title: Dual spectral sparsity
statement: Let $V$ be a finite-dimensional vector space over $\mathbb{F}_2$, and let $f:V\to\bbr$. The dual spectral sparsity of $f$ is the number of linear functionals on $V$ at which its dual Fourier coefficient is nonzero.
hypotheses_covered: $V$ is an additive commutative group and an $\mathbb{F}_2$-vector space
